# 1.0.9 beta 3

This beta fixes the Settings Restore Defaults footer in compact layouts and at high UI scale.

- Keep the Restore Defaults description in its own wrapping column so it cannot overlap or clip against the action button. This covers narrow windows such as the 560 px minimum width and 150% UI scaling.
- Added a headless regression test that verifies the footer geometry at 560 px and 150% scale; the existing 800×740 check now uses the same transformed-bounds assertion.
- Automated coverage is now 168 tests (163 Core + 5 headless UI).

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
